_doc: Thủy Vân's places (ThuyVanCanon.place), the bible's atlas L01-L14 and L16. Public fields only. Every row: id, src (bible ids), status, and the same {text, voice} display strings as peoples.json; proposal_fields names the fields still waiting on the owner.

name: the bible's name. vi_name: the Vietnamese name where one exists (null where none is given yet). title: the English title shown with it. peoples: people ids at home there. reveal_book: the first book a place may be shown or named in the game.
name_book: where a place's name itself belongs to a later book; book1_label is what Book I calls it instead.
The atlas is topology, not a map: distances live in routes.json as the bible's travel windows. No river list until the owner names the nine.

title.text: Cửu Giang Delta, the Nine Rivers

line.text: Lowland rice country of levees, locks and barges, where every boat waits its turn at the gates.

title.text: Vạn Thủy, Capital of the Waters

line.text: The capital on its islands, all bells and canal steps, where nothing moves without a pass.

title.text: Đá Trắng, the White Stone Reach

line.text: A white-stoned river in the foothill gorges; the clans fish it, cross it, and keep its upper reach for their dead.
The high range of hanging bridges and terraces, where a pass can close for a season.
Quarry valleys under the western ridges, loud with chisels and kiln smoke.
Southern wetlands of stilt platforms and reed screens, which the toll maps still draw as open water.
A Floodborn hold deep in the freshwater marshes, which few outsiders have ever seen.

title.text: Vực Sen Sâu, the Deep Lotus Reaches

line.text: Lotus basins and flooded caves, where the Riverborn keep their channels closed to strangers.

title.text: Ảo Thành, the City of Illusions

line.text: A Hồ Tinh city in the western market corridor, open only to those who are expected.
The great western forest, wet and old, where the groves give leave or do not.

title.text: the Ancestor Roads, the Shrine Circuit

line.text: A circuit of shrine houses and pilgrim roads, each house a stop of its own.

title.text: the Southern Delta Provinces, the Salt Ports

line.text: Estuary ports of salt, ships and warehouses, richer than they let the court see.
A chain of fishing villages along the eastern shore, east of the marshes.
Old galleries beneath the river works; few have seen them.

title.text: Two Heights Bridge, the Northern Crossing

line.text: The great bridge between the high passes and the Stone Valleys, where clans and Stone Houses both collect their tolls and their grudges.
